### What this PR does / why we need it?
This pull request removes the `torch.abs` operation on `combine_metadata.expanded_row_idx` before passing it as `sorted_indices` to `torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute` within the `token_combine` method.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No.

### How was this patch tested?
No tests were included in this pull request.


- vLLM version: v0.22.1
- vLLM main: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/967c5c3bc38891f4465d3f4e99917ed837bb3833

pull_request.head: fix_allgather

         )
         return results
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def npu_moe_token_unpermute(permuted_tokens, sorted_indices, probs):
+        return torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute(
+            permuted_tokens=permuted_tokens, sorted_indices=torch.abs(sorted_indices), probs=probs
+        )
+
 
 class A5DeviceAdaptor(BaseDeviceAdaptor):
     @classmethod
@@ -1673,6 +1679,12 @@ def split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope(
         )

+    @staticmethod

+        return torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute(
+            permuted_tokens=permuted_tokens, sorted_indices=sorted_indices, probs=probs
+        )
+

-        final_hidden_states = torch_npu.npu_moe_token_unpermute(

```markdown
This PR updates the MoE (Mixture of Experts) token dispatching and combining logic for Ascend devices. ### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
No.

### How was this patch tested?
Please verify with existing MoE tests.
```
